text:
megan: Heads up: SummitRetail exec escalation. POC hit a hard blocker — their network team requires egress through TLS-inspected proxy + fixed IPs. They also asked for a 6-figure annual committed pricing for Dedicated. Need engineering + security input. @liam @olivia
liam: On it. Can we get exact proxy behaviour? Is it a MITM TLS proxy that re-signs certs? That affects our client-side cert pinning.
olivia: Yes they're doing TLS interception. That's not compatible with our managed agent unless we run in their VPC/private. Short term options: 1) Private deployment in their VPC 2) Dedicated in their region + static NAT + VPN 3) On-prem appliance. Each has timeline/cost tradeoffs.
megan: They want timeline this week. Sales asked for 'dedicated + static egress' option. @nate can you pull rough engineering lead time and minimal pricing delta?
nate: Rough estimates: VPC Private: 6-8 weeks + infra fees. Dedicated w/ static NAT & VPN: 3-4 weeks, + 30% price uplift to cover reserved capacity and egress. On-prem: 8-12 weeks + integration. I'll write a short appendix for pricing.
ava: Legal: attach standard DPA + we can do SOC2 attestation in 2 weeks. For TLS inspection, they want a certificate sharing clause — need to review. I'll draft an NDA addendum.
megan: Customer also requested IP allowlist for outbound to 3rd-party data connectors (analytics). @liam is there a config snippet I can send?
liam: Yes — sending patch below: ```egress_rules:
  - dest: 13.58.76.0/24
  - dest: 52.23.11.0/24
  - protocol: tcp
  - ports: [443]
``` That plus static NAT should satisfy their firewall.
olivia: Security note: If traffic is MITM'd, KV cache and user-provided keys may be at risk. Recommend Private deployment or customer-managed KMS. Ping infra for HSM options.
megan: Customer exec wants pricing and plan by EOD Thursday, and a short slide for their CTO on security mitigations. Can someone own slides? @nate?
nate: I'll own slides and pricing appendix. Deliver by Wednesday COB. I'll include fallback plan for canary and rollback.
liam: I can scope the VPN + static NAT config (network playbook) — will upload to the thread once done.
olivia: I'll review slide security section and add mitigation bullets. Also will prepare a short Q&A for their auditor.
megan: :rotating_light: Action items recap — Nate: pricing & slides (due Wed COB). Liam: network playbook + egress CIDR list (due Tue). Olivia: security Q&A + DPA addendum review (due Wed). Ava: legal draft (due Wed). I'll run the exec call Thurs 10am PT. Customer contact: Ryan (CTO).
deploy-bot: Reminder: kickoff call scheduled 2026-03-25 17:00 UTC — calendar invite sent to participants.
megan: Thanks all. If we hit anything blocking, flag here and I'll escalate to CTO.
